name: amaaov
author: amaaov
tagline: Juggling court generators on the FM-1
description: Holding Topology HT-1 runs seed-driven court generators on the M-VAVE FM-1: PLAY rolls a unique seed, knobs bias tempo feedback and wildness, keys follow a seeded role map, and the LCD shows a juggling court. Device DSP covers waveguide pipes/strings, tape loop, scatter delay, and analog character; the browser demo keeps the full Web Audio engine set.
credits: App and court generators by amaaov. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0), from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
